entries.source:
This is a trial version of Nimble Commander-Fork.
To continue using this software after the 30-day trial period, you have to either buy a license or install the paid version from Mac App Store.
This window appears only in the trial version.

זוהי גרסת ניסיון של Nimble Commander-Fork.
